body:
I think we are redefining the behaviour due to CD (as discussed elsewhere, I will repeat it here to keep track of rationale).
Consider:

- CRGE=0 then
    - CRW=0 -> strip tag on load / fault on store
    - CRW=1 -> normal operation
- CRGE=1 then
     - CRW=0 (CD=0, CRG=0) -> strip tag on load / fault on store
     - CRW=1 (CD=0, CRG=0) -> either CD=1 on store or fault on store for CD emulation.

So we actually re-define the base spec PTE.CRW=1 behaviour as PTE.CRW=1, PTE.CD=1, PTE.CRG=0. This is also spelled out at the beginning of the chapter as "minimum level of PTE support".
